name: OfficeQA Pro
intro: OfficeQA Pro 是 OfficeQA Full 的 133 道困难子集，来源于同一套 1939–2025 年美国财政部公报；当两个前沿智能体都无法借助解析文档正确回答时，问题才进入 Pro。它强调跨公报、联网、视觉和超越基础算术的复杂分析。
build_method: 人工命题, 独立答案复现, 双智能体难度筛选
metric: 确定性正确率（精确匹配或绝对相对误差）
modality: 文本, PDF文档, 表格, 图表
task_type: 高难文档问答, 检索增强Agent任务
eval_feature: 多文档推理, 外部检索, 视觉与高级分析
scale: 133道困难问题；同源语料约89,000页、超过2,600万数值
task_type_en: Hard Document QA, Retrieval-augmented Agent Tasks
build_method_en: Human Question Authoring, Independent Answer Reproduction, Two-agent Difficulty Filtering
eval_feature_en: Multi-document Reasoning, External Retrieval, Visual and Advanced Analysis
intro_en: OfficeQA Pro is the 133-question hard subset of OfficeQA Full, grounded in the same U.S. Treasury Bulletin corpus from 1939–2025. A question enters Pro only when both frontier agents fail to answer it correctly using the parsed documents; the subset emphasizes cross-bulletin, web, visual, and beyond-basic-arithmetic analysis.
scale_en: 133 hard questions; source corpus of about 89,000 pages and more than 26M numeric values
metric_en: Deterministic Accuracy (Exact Match or Absolute Relative Error)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08655 and the official databricks/officeqa repository. OfficeQA Pro shares OfficeQA Full's 1939–2025 Treasury Bulletin corpus, text-layer removal, question-authoring criteria, scaled annotation, USAFacts review, independent reproduction and adjudication, two end-to-end agent-QA passes, and parametric-knowledge filter. The diagrams then preserve the distinct Pro gate: remove the 113 questions both frontier agents answer correctly from the parsed corpus and retain 133 hard questions. The released subset includes questions spanning one to more than 20 pages; the paper reports 11% using at least three bulletins, 22% requiring the web, 3% visual, and 62% beyond basic arithmetic. Grading uses the same deterministic normalization and exact or absolute-relative-error rules as OfficeQA Full.
